meta.title: Route B (engine B), PART Q: defect cycles of Q_1 (xi), S_1 (eta), K_1 (K_b); momentum-space numerator algebra, Feynman parameters, numerical eps-extrapolation
meta.unit: coefficients in units hbar/(16 pi^2) times the colour words C_w = (1 (x) ad_{Y_w1} ... ad_{Y_wr})(-,-)^{-1} (X_a on the first factor); planar adjacent pair: (-1)^r a/2 units u = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2), outputs in trace order Y_wr ... Y_w1
meta.names: Xa[comp], Xb[comp]: letter components; Y<j>[comp]: output polarisations; p<j>_m: output momenta (i p_m = d_m on that output); xi<j>: components of xi in Sigma (realisation of engine_b/realization.py: j = 4a + A, a in {0,1} the S_+ index, A in 0..3 the W index; xi in S_+ (x) W has j = 0..7); eta<j>: Sigma^* components; b<m>: vector; engine vector index 0 <-> two-component m = 4, 1,2,3 <-> 1,2,3 (step2/notation/dictionary.json); comp names of tl_engine: A_m, A_I1..A_I6, lam_a<a>^<i> (lambda_+ = lambda_alpha^i), lambar_ad<a>_<i> (lambda_- = lambdabar_alphadot i), lams^a<a>_<i> (lambda*_+), lambars^ad<a><i> (lambda*_-), As_*, cs
meta.regulator: Schwinger cutoff t >= eps on every edge P(eps, oo) (T = infinity at generic momenta), special edge K_eps - K_0 with t in [0, eps] and numerator -|k|^2 k0; no dimensional regularisation; no IR regulator other than T (= infinity here)
meta.machine: pure Python (sympy rings over Q(i), fractions, mpmath); one heavy process at a time; code src.nosync/, raw outputs out.nosync/

recorded.canonical_form: two-leg outputs on plane waves alpha delta + beta^mu d_mu delta + gamma^{mu nu} d_mu d_nu delta <-> int omega (x^mu x^nu K_munu + x^mu K_mu + K_0): K_0 = alpha, K_mu = i beta^mu, K_munu = -gamma^{munu}; route B computes position factors as -i d/dr (one) and -d^2/dr dr (two) of a momentum r injected at the S vertex and absorbed by omega
recorded.twisted_coefficient: Q^xi_1 = L_1^(0) + Q_1 - (1/2) L_1^(2)(xi,xi) (Def c8-twisted, Prop qs-twist (i)); used as stated
recorded.colour_T5: T5 = (1/4) sum_{MN} ([A_M,A_N], (rho_M rho_N xi, lam*)) carries the colour key f of vertices.py and acts on the cycle as ad_Y of its output Y, like a cubic vertex of I (Rem qs-colour)

Sigma.expected: S^V_2 = T1 + T3, S^perp_2 = T2 + T4

Sigma*.expected: S^V_2(eta) = x.(T1+T3), S^perp_2(eta) = x.(T2+T4) + s0: the intrinsic direction s_0 is tied to the perp position part; no closed intrinsic direction alone

TQ0.exactness_count: degree -2 quadratic contents: (A*,A*) w=6, (A*,lam*) 11/2, (lam*,lam*) 5, (c*,A) 5, (c*,lam) 11/2, (c*,c*) 8: all > 9/2 (and > 7/2): no exact direction
TQ0.K_b: not run in route B (position degree <= 2; open)

G_reg_Pb.statement: sum over pairs of Upsilon_{P_b} on the scalar bilinear = C^(2)_{P_b} = -(1/6) u b.d(A A) per adjacent pair = -(1/3) u d_b O (Cor qs-DP); no eps^-1 term

TQ7.Delta: not run in route B (needs the position part of S^(1)(Delta) with the injected momentum; open)

TQ2.xi: S_+ (x) W, symbolic xi0..xi7 (or by components)

constant_numerator.statement: F8 (closed form, restated in the revision): 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = F_0 log(n_t/(n_t-1))/(n_t-1)! for a cycle with n_t edges whose eps^0 integrand F_0 is a constant (the leg sets with superficial degree D = 0, which carry no pole); 16 pi^2 [eps^-1] = F_1/(n_t^2 (n_t-1)(n_t-1)!) for a constant m = 1 integrand F_1 (superficial degree D = 2); verified exactly for n_t = 2..6.

closed_forms.bubble: n_t = 2 (Prop qs-small (i)): int_0^{1/2} log((1-alpha)/alpha) dalpha = log 2; the G-cubic chain gives 16 pi^2 x value = (-1/(2 eps) - (3/8)|q|^2) x factor (gate G-cubic)
closed_forms.D0_legsets: for D = 0 leg sets the kernel is a rational multiple of log(3/2)/2 (n_t = 3) or of log(4/3)/6 (n_t = 4) chain by chain (only the bases log2, log3 with opposite coefficients occur)

findings: F1 (E0): with the operator-functional reading of Prop c1-Q / Prop c7-susy (F = (1/2)<e,Xe>, checked on the free action), xi. maps lam -> +Gamma(xi,lam) and A -> +(1/2) rho(dA) xi; Lemma qs-arrows prints the opposite overall sign (reading int(Xe,e*) <-> X). Consequently the lam -> c component of C_xi is +i(p,Gamma(xi,lam)|_V) and the composite line 2(P* xi. P* (x) 1)K_0 is -2 xi e^{-2eps p^2}/p^2 on c (x) lam_+ and +2 xi e^{-2 eps p^2}/p^2 on lam_+ (x) c (real; Rem qs-twocomp expected +-2i).
F2 (E0): C_xi has only the components lam_- -> c, A*|_V -> lam_+, lam*_+ -> A|_V, c* -> lam*_- (xi in S_+ (x) W); the A*|_perp -> lam and lam* -> A|_perp parts of xi.Q^GF and Q^GF xi. cancel.

F3 (E0): the operator induced by S_2(eta) is x^mu xi_mu. (normal-ordered field arrows) + eta^0. + Y, Y the constant antifield arrows lam* -> A* from integrating x^mu by parts (pairing preservation); [eta.,Q] = 0 holds with Y and fails with eta^0. alone as printed in Prop qs-comm (ii).

F4 (TQ0): along Sigma^* the closed quadratic directions of position degree <= 1 are x.(T1+T3) and x.(T2+T4) + s_0; s_0 is not an independent closed direction (Prop qs-freexi, last sentence, lists it as additional).

F5 (sign rule): in route B the defect cycles are D_x = +(hbar/2) sum s_x STr[...], s_x the Koszul factor of Def qs-defect (ii) WITHOUT its leading minus (special-edge parameter first, then for even x the CE coordinate). Fixed by G-pole on (A_perp, lam_+)|_{A_perp} (odd x, discriminating) and G-reg along P_b (even x). Same convention as composite engine B (Z_x = +(hbar/4) sum s(c,sigma) STr).

F6 (G-pole): for gauge-variant letters (general colour polarisations) the pole identity eq qs-pole needs the vacuum-pole x spectator terms: the cubic part of {S^(1)(xi),O} with the vacuum two-letter pole ct_1(A A) = 2(za.zb), and ct1_{xi,1}(sO) with the vacuum counterterm cycle ct1_xi(c, lam_+)|_0 = (1/2)(xi.zb) (the lam-c composite line closed on the pair); with them the identity holds exactly on the four gaugino pairs and on the pair of Example qs-cubic; they vanish only on colour singlets.

F7 (TQ3): Upsilon_xi(A_perp, lam_+) vanishes identically on the leg set lam_- lam_- at n = 0 (all letter, output and colour components, xi general): 16 nonzero configurations, each a rational multiple of log(4/3)/6, cancel. The beta gamma entry [BK (3.66)] is therefore not carried by the arity-one two-body kernel at n = 0 in this regularisation; the b c entry with b <-> (xi, lam*) (pair (c, lam*_+) -> lam_- lam_-) also vanishes. beta beta [BK (3.67)] is nonzero, antisymmetric in I, J, linear in the momenta.

F8 (closed form, restated in the revision): 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = F_0 log(n_t/(n_t-1))/(n_t-1)! for a cycle with n_t edges whose eps^0 integrand F_0 is a constant (the leg sets with superficial degree D = 0, which carry no pole); 16 pi^2 [eps^-1] = F_1/(n_t^2 (n_t-1)(n_t-1)!) for a constant m = 1 integrand F_1 (superficial degree D = 2); verified exactly for n_t = 2..6.

F9 (TQ4): two-body part of Q_1 on the scalar bilinear O = int omega (iota_w1 A, iota_w2 A) (colour singlet, units u): -2 log(3/2) u {S^(1)(xi),O} on A_perp lam_+, plus the trace structures 4 log(3/2) u (w1.w2)(rho(Y_A) xi, Y_lam) on A_perp lam_+ and 4 log(3/2) u (w1.w2) Gamma(xi,Y_lam)|_V . Y_AV on A_V lam_-; the leg sets lam_- and c lam*_+ vanish on the singlet; no poles. The one-body term -{hbar F_1^(1)(xi), O} needs TQ1 (not computed), so c_Q itself is open; its two-body part -2 log(3/2) is cutoff-shape dependent.
